爱莎贝儿-140CM-M 粉肤 RAD018 朝仓奈绪美Asakura Naomi-扎针时的亲昵靠近
我吓得闭紧眼睛，她单手托住我的小臂，整个人俯身贴过来。
淡粉发梢扫过我下颌，紫瞳湿漉漉盯着我，温热呼吸喷在我耳边轻声哄我，指尖慢悠悠摩挲我的皮肤。
她舌头轻轻舔了下下唇，我心跳猛撞胸腔，不敢抬头看她。
我脸红红的心想每天都生病的话该有多好。
身型：140CM-M 粉肤

Elsa Babe-140CM-M Pink RAD018 Asakura Naomi-Intimate Approach During an Injection
I closed my eyes tightly in fright. She supported my forearm with one hand and leaned closer.
Her pale pink hair brushed against my chin, her moist purple eyes stared at me, her warm breath tickled my ear as she softly coaxed me, her fingertips slowly caressing my skin.
She lightly licked her lower lip with her tongue, my heart pounded in my chest, and I dared not look up at her.
My face flushed, and I thought how wonderful it would be to be sick every day.
Body type: 140CM-M with Pink skin tone.
